_comment: Advisories checked by hand and found unreachable. `functions/tools/audit-check.js`
fails the build on any advisory ID absent from this file, so adding an entry is
a decision, not a formality: it says someone traced the code path and it is not
there. Delete an entry the moment the reason stops holding.
Both packages arrive through `mailauth`, which we use for exactly one thing --
modules. `undici` accounts for none of them and `nodemailer` for one file,
`nanoid` is the exception: it is genuinely loaded, and the entry says why the
vulnerable function is still not reachable.

acknowledged.1120795: nodemailer — CRLF injection in List-* header comments. Not loaded; we never build or send a message with nodemailer.
acknowledged.1120796: nodemailer — jsonTransport bypasses disableFileAccess. Transport code is not loaded.
acknowledged.1120797: nodemailer — TLS validation in OAuth2 token fetch. No OAuth2, no SMTP.
acknowledged.1121191: nodemailer — message-level raw option enables file read and SSRF. Requires calling sendMail; nothing does.
acknowledged.1121187: undici — SOCKS5 ProxyAgent TLS bypass. undici is not loaded on the dkim path.
acknowledged.1121241: undici — Set-Cookie percent-decoding header injection. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1121244: undici — WebSocket fragment-count DoS. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1121247: undici — cross-origin routing via SOCKS5 pool reuse. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1121254: undici — SameSite downgrade via substring matching. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1121428: undici — shared cache whitespace bypass. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1130715: undici — response desynchronization via retry interceptor. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1130718: undici — degenerate private cache directives. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1130726: undici — CRLF injection via blob-like body type. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1130729: undici — whitespace around equals in Cache-Control. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1130731: undici — cookie attribute injection via unsanitized domain. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1137242: undici — response queue poisoning via keep-alive socket reuse. Not loaded.
acknowledged.1139427: nanoid — custom generators loop forever when size is 0. Arrives through sanitize-html → postcss, which is loaded. The advisory is about customAlphabet/customRandom; postcss's only call is `nanoid(6)` in lib/input.js, a literal size on the plain generator, and it names an input that has no file. No caller of ours reaches the size argument.
